fieldValueStringLengthConflict.sourceTraceObservation: The installed LibreDWG 0.14 trace decodes group 98 as BL on this source (for example FIELD 0x151d0 has value_string_length=88 at cursor 19.5); for table-linked fields the S30 body/handle cursors and following-object boundaries also match the libdxfrw BL parser.
fieldValueStringLengthConflict.disposition: Do not change the current BL wire handling based on the ODA table alone. Keep the discrepancy explicit and resolve only with stronger primary/source-bound evidence. The four raw-only classes in this receipt are not attributed to group-98 type disagreement.

findings.result: The strict gate is correct to refuse the current full-drawing export. Enabling the selected 30-record serializer by pruning the other 132 FIELDLIST members or silently omitting 66 raw-only FIELDs would lose source data. The existing code already has typed FIELD/FIELDLIST DXF encoders for bounded supported values; the missing work is complete AC1021 FIELD carrier preservation and the legacy TABLE/MTEXT owner/reference publication route.

limits: The 66-frame classification and parser diagnostics are local reader observations on one producer-bound source; they do not prove that every raw-only CadValue can be decoded from the current evidence.
LibreDWG minJSON field identities and the S29/S30 cursor receipts provide independent object/graph evidence but do not qualify DXF output or native FIELD evaluation.
No FIELD/FIELDLIST graph output or DXF readback is established by this receipt.
No DWG/DXF fixture or derivative was added to the repository.

closed: P5-A source-span evidence for the 30 TABLE-linked FIELD records (S29/S30).
Trace strict refusal to the source-format and graph-shape admission gate.
Count and classify the 66 source FIELD frames not represented by complete typed records.
remaining: Use ODA §20.4.99 plus source-bound cursors to resolve the four raw-only categories without guessing CadValue or tail layouts.
Preserve all 162 FIELDLIST identities and every source owner/object reference in the typed model or an explicit lossless output route; do not prune the FIELDLIST to force admission.
Add the AC1021 legacy embedded TABLE/MTEXT FIELD-index and nested-dictionary graph closure after complete FIELD carrier coverage exists.
Then qualify strict ASCII and Binary output, destination-preserving refusal, same-adapter retry, and fresh ACadSharp graph/value readback.
implementationReadiness.nextAction: Map one raw-only category at a time against ODA and the already captured source cursors. Add no serializer admission for this DWG until all 162 FIELDLIST members and their live references have a lossless output disposition.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: Keep the hash-bound DWG and all generated DXF outputs in scratch; commit no new DWG/DXF fixtures.
